values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be Euclidean open and $X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ be smooth and regular on $\Omega$. At $q\in\Omega$, put $U=X_u(q)$ and $V=X_v(q)$; these form a basis of $T_qX$. Let $J\subseteq\mathbb R$ be an open interval, $\alpha=(u,v):J\to\Omega$ be $C^1$, and $\gamma=X\circ\alpha$. Then $\|\dot\gamma(t)\|^2=\mathrm I_X(\alpha(t);\dot\gamma(t),\dot\gamma(t))=E\dot u^2+2F\dot u\dot v+G\dot v^2$, with coefficients at $\alpha(t)$. For $[t_0,t_1]\subset J$, its length is $\int_{t_0}^{t_1}\sqrt{E\dot u^2+2F\dot u\dot v+G\dot v^2}\,dt$. For nonzero $w,z\in T_qX$, their angle $\theta\in[0,\pi]$ satisfies $\cos\theta=\mathrm I_X(q;w,z)/\sqrt{\mathrm I_X(q;w,w)\mathrm I_X(q;z,z)}$. No unit-speed assumption is used.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 为欧氏开集，$X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑且正则。取 $q\in\Omega$，记 $U=X_u(q)$、$V=X_v(q)$，它们构成 $T_qX$ 的一组基。设开区间 $J\subseteq\mathbb R$ 上有 $C^1$ 曲线 $\alpha=(u,v):J\to\Omega$，令 $\gamma=X\circ\alpha$。则 $\|\dot\gamma(t)\|^2=\mathrm I_X(\alpha(t);\dot\gamma(t),\dot\gamma(t))=E\dot u^2+2F\dot u\dot v+G\dot v^2$，系数在 $\alpha(t)$ 处取值。对 $[t_0,t_1]\subset J$，曲线长度是 $\int_{t_0}^{t_1}\sqrt{E\dot u^2+2F\dot u\dot v+G\dot v^2}\,dt$。对非零 $w,z\in T_qX$，夹角 $\theta\in[0,\pi]$ 满足 $\cos\theta=\mathrm I_X(q;w,z)/\sqrt{\mathrm I_X(q;w,w)\mathrm I_X(q;z,z)}$。不要求单位速。
